## SLA Standard

|---|---|---|

| **P1** | In-room defect impacting guest experience (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, lock) | **8 hours** |
| **P2** | Cosmetic / minor defect (paint, grout, fixture, furniture) | **7 days** |
| **P3** | Preventive / non-guest-facing / scheduled work | **Next PM window** |
